checksum: CRC32: top 10 asks ascending then top 10 bids descending

clock.perf_counter_nanoseconds: frame receipt, candidate state processed/CRC validated, feature compute and synchronous in-process feature sink; comparable within this process/session

timestamp_fields.received_at: local UTC wall clock sampled immediately after websocket frame receipt
timestamp_fields.received_monotonic_ns: local monotonic nanoseconds sampled at frame receipt; session-local
timestamp_fields.processed_at: local UTC wall clock after parse, book update, and checksum validation
timestamp_fields.processed_monotonic_ns: local monotonic nanoseconds after validation; session-local
timestamp_fields.state_processed_monotonic_ns: time.perf_counter_ns after candidate L2 update and shape validation, before CRC check
timestamp_fields.state_validated_monotonic_ns: time.perf_counter_ns after successful CRC and state commit; absent on invalid messages
timestamp_fields.feature_compute_started_monotonic_ns: time.perf_counter_ns immediately before frozen V3 batch function on current causal resample
timestamp_fields.feature_ready_monotonic_ns: time.perf_counter_ns immediately before synchronous in-process feature sink receives a valid V3 row; sidecar is persisted at capture finalization
